items.exampleEn: He has a big collection of toy cars.
My grandfather reads the newspaper every morning.
items.exampleZh: 我爺爺每天早上看報紙。

items.exampleEn: Let's watch a video about cats.
items.exampleZh: 我們來看一部關於貓的影片吧。

items.exampleEn: The children go to summer camp.
I am a big fan of this singer.
items.exampleZh: 我是這位歌手的超級粉絲。

items.exampleEn: I am in the school music club.

items.sentenceEn: We watch a video of the game.

items.audioEn: Our coach shows us a video of the game.
items.audioZh: 我們的教練給我們看比賽的影片。

items.sentenceEn: My sister is a fan of this band.
items.sentenceZh: 我姊姊是這個樂團的粉絲。

items.sentenceEn: Do you want to join our club?
items.sentenceZh: 你想加入我們的社團嗎？

items.stemEn: I read about the game in the ____.
items.stemZh: 我在報紙上讀到這場比賽的消息。

items.stemEn: Our ____ teaches us how to play basketball.
items.stemZh: 我們的教練教我們怎麼打籃球。

items.passageEn: Mr. Wu is an art fan. He has a big collection of paintings in his home. Every Sunday, he goes to the art club in town. He also teaches a painting class at a summer camp for children. Many newspapers write about him.
items.passageZh: 吳先生是藝術迷。他家裡收藏了很多畫作。每個星期天，他都去鎮上的美術社。他也在兒童夏令營教繪畫課。很多報紙都報導過他。

questions.questionZh: 吳先生家裡收藏了什麼？
吳先生在夏令營做什麼？

items.promptZh: 我參加了學校的籃球社。
referenceEn: I am in the school basketball club.
I joined the basketball club at school.
rubricZh: 「參加社團」可用 be in a club、join a club 等
加入的動作已經發生可用過去式（例如 joined）；用 am in 描述現在狀態也正確

items.instructionZh: 用 fan 造一個句子，說說你是誰（或什麼）的粉絲。
referenceEn: I am a big fan of this band.
I am a fan of Japanese food.
rubricZh: 「是⋯的粉絲」例如 a fan of this band；用所有格（例如 his fan、Amy's fan）也正確
可加 big 加強語氣（例如 a big fan），沒加也正確
